en: Now, if you are using an AI agent on a
system, as I'm doing it here on a VPS,
sometimes permissions can be a problem. And
the main takeaway, just to get that out of
the way, is that
there isn't really a secure way around this
problem. If you want to give your agent more
permissions, you have to live with the fact
that more things can go wrong.
Or if you don't want to give it the
permissions, you have to live with the fact
that it can't do as much stuff. You have to
choose one of these 2 things essentially.
With that in mind though, what you can do
outside of the agent
is you can edit your VPS user, or you can
create a new one for the agent and edit it
such that it can get sudo access for all
commands or certain commands
without being asked for the password, with
all the negative consequences this has, of
course.
What you can do
is you can run a command called
visudo,
with sudo in front of it since this requires
elevated privilege,
-f /etc/sudoers,
This will open up a text editor again.
And in there, you can now enter your
username,
then all=all:all
like this,
nopassword:all.
What this means essentially is that for the
user Max, we won't ask for a password for
all commands.
If you wanted to limit this to certain
commands instead of typing all here,
you can instead just list the specific
commands here that
it should be allowed to execute without a
password.
For that, however, you need to include the
full path to where that tool is installed.
For example,
/usr/bin/systemctl like this,
And then even say something like restart. So
that would allow to run the restart command
without a password, but no other commands.
So you could be more restrictive here.
Here for demo purposes, I'll use all instead
and then hit Ctrl+X and Y to save and hit
Enter.
And now if I run
sudo ls/,
I can run this without entering a password.
Again, this has disadvantages. Obviously, if
someone gets access to this user, they can
perform tasks as a root user without being
the root user, without being asked for a
password. Now, since we locked down the
server quite a bit,
we are more secure, but of course not 100%
secure. So that can be an issue. In
addition, the AI of course now can also do
all kinds of stuff. Nonetheless, to show you
what you can do now, if I now Again, start
the PyCoding agent.
I can
grab that URL to this Docker article, or
I'll just copy the content as Markdown.
And then I could give this AI a task like,
please install Docker
as explained in this article.
And then here I like to do these XML tags.
That is optional though, not required. I'll
paste my Markdown content here.
And then again, I'll say follow these
installation instructions
step by step.
And it should now be able to install Docker
as
instructed in the official docs because it
has those sudo permissions. So it will be
able to execute sudo commands
without being prompted for a password, which
naturally would fail.
So now it
gets to work here.
Already executed a sudo command here
and it's done.
And that can of course be
convenient with all the disadvantages I
mentioned. But still
having an AI agent on a VPS can be useful.
If you wanna use it, of course it's your
personal decision.
